findings.claim: RHAI nine-domain-audit and the project-domain generator point at missing library cards and a prompt id that REGISTRY.yaml does not define.
findings.broken_invariant: Operator workflow card_path/prompt_id must resolve to REGISTRY.yaml entries and existing files.
findings.observation: ALL_DOMAINS card_path values for docs-content, tests-system, docs-pipeline, and architecture-review do not exist; REGISTRY maps those domains to library/doc/audit.md, library/test/system-audit.md, library/doc/pipeline.md, and library/audit/architecture-review.md. RHAI prompt_id prompt.audit.docs-content is absent from REGISTRY (id is prompt.docs.audit).
findings.method: Path.exists on RHAI card_path vs REGISTRY.yaml entries.path; grep prompt.audit.docs-content in REGISTRY.yaml (no match).
findings.expected: Each RHAI/generator card_path equals the REGISTRY.yaml path for that prompt_id, and the file exists.
findings.actual: Four card_path files missing; prompt.audit.docs-content not in REGISTRY; same stale list in generate_project_domain_audit_workflow.py:137-145; orchestrator.md:115 and library/doc/pipeline.md:49 still cite prompt.audit.docs-content.
findings.impact: Nine-domain fan-out agents cannot load the audit card; audits fail or invent scope. Wrong build/release equivalent for this operator kit.

evidence.output: MISSING library/audit/docs-content.md tests-system.md docs-pipeline.md library/architecture/review-assessment.md; REGISTRY paths exist

findings.acceptance: RHAI ALL_DOMAINS and generator all_prompts use REGISTRY paths; prompt_id matches entries.id; Test-Path/CI fails if a card is missing.
findings.rollback: Revert RHAI/generator path edits only; do not edit .codex/.junie.
findings.remediation: Align nine-domain-audit.rhai and generate_project_domain_audit_workflow.py card_path/prompt_id with REGISTRY.yaml; add a unit test that every RHAI card_path exists and matches the registry entry.
findings.automation: Extend tests/unit/scripts/ai/test_prompt_library.py to parse RHAI ALL_DOMAINS against REGISTRY.yaml

findings.claim: AGENTS.md and POST_CHANGE_VALIDATION document POSIX bash + bare python -m, while CODEX-RUNTIME and Grok skills require .venv-win on native Windows.
findings.broken_invariant: Documented post-change commands must be executable on the first-class Windows operator path.
findings.observation: Post-change mirror check is specified only as bash scripts/ai/junie/check_junie_mirror.sh --check. Python checker scripts/ai/junie/check_junie_mirror.py --check exited 0 on this Windows checkout. AGENTS.md also uses bare python -m for coverage/inventory; CODEX-RUNTIME.md:127 requires .venv-win/Scripts/python.exe. Grok bioetl-session SKILL.md:19 locks .venv-win then line 63 uses bare python -m scripts.docs generate-cleanup-inventory.
findings.method: Inspection of AGENTS.md, POST_CHANGE_VALIDATION.md, CODEX-RUNTIME.md, grok bioetl-session SKILL.md; ran Python mirror checker.
findings.expected: Windows operators have an explicit Python/.venv-win command that satisfies the same gate as the bash wrapper.
findings.actual: bash wrapper is the only command in AGENTS.md/POST_CHANGE; tests/architecture/test_junie_runtime_ci_contract.py asserts the bash string. Python equivalent exists and is green here; no .ps1 wrapper.
findings.impact: Windows agents skip or fail required runtime-mirror validation, or invoke the wrong interpreter.
findings.acceptance: AGENTS.md and POST_CHANGE list the Python Windows command beside bash; Grok session skill uses .venv-win for cleanup-inventory.
findings.remediation: Document Windows: .venv-win\Scripts\python.exe scripts/ai/junie/check_junie_mirror.py --check next to the bash line; replace bare python -m in AGENTS.md/Grok session skill with the Windows interpreter when describing native Windows.
findings.automation: Keep CI on bash; add a docs/contract test that POST_CHANGE mentions check_junie_mirror.py

findings.claim: install_skills.ps1 installs skills/agents/personas from docs/00-project/ai/grok/ but never copies tracked RHAI workflows.
findings.broken_invariant: Documented Grok install path should materialize the tracked workflow used for nine-domain audits, or the README must say it is manual-only.
findings.observation: install_skills.ps1 copies SKILL.md, agents/*.md, personas/*.toml only. nine-domain-audit.rhai header says copy to .grok/workflows/ for /workflow invoke. docs/00-project/ai/grok/README.md Layout table omits workflows/. generate_project_domain_audit_workflow.py emits a second machine-local project-domain-audit.rhai with the same stale card paths.
findings.method: Read install_skills.ps1 destinations; glob scripts/ai/grok/workflows; grep grok README for workflows.
findings.expected: Either install_skills.ps1 copies tracked .rhai into ~/.grok/workflows (or -Project .grok/workflows) with -WhatIf, or README/runbook states the manual copy and a single canonical workflow file.
findings.actual: No workflow copy in the installer; two generator/RHAI sources; Grok README does not mention nine-domain-audit.rhai.
findings.impact: Operators who only run install_skills.ps1 cannot invoke the nine-domain kit; those who copy RHAI still hit AGT-001 missing cards.

evidence.output: Source roots: skills, agents, personas only; no workflows destination

findings.acceptance: README documents workflow install-or-skip; installer and RHAI share one path list.
findings.remediation: Add optional workflow copy in install_skills.ps1 (or document manual copy in Grok README) after AGT-001 path fix; do not treat prompts/RHAI as runtime SSOT.
validation: README mentions workflows or installer copies .rhai

findings.claim: Nine-domain RHAI labels domain agents capability_mode read-only while the spawned prompt requires writing report.md and findings.json.
findings.broken_invariant: Write of audit artifacts must match the agent's declared capability.
findings.observation: RHAI sets capability_mode read-only then tells the agent to write artifacts under report_dir. Grok py-audit-bot.md has permission_mode: plan and Remain read-only. Codex py-audit-bot.toml sandbox_mode=read-only. Domain cards including agents-runtime.md require reports/audit/<domain>/report.md + findings.json. Synthesis job correctly uses read-write.
findings.method: Read RHAI jobs.push capability_mode vs prompt write sentence; compare Grok/Codex py-audit-bot sandbox.
findings.expected: Domain audit jobs that must persist artifacts use a narrow write capability limited to reports/audit/**, or the parent writes files from structured output.
findings.actual: read-only capability + mandatory file writes; Grok py-audit-bot plan mode has no file editing tools.
findings.impact: Domain agents return JSON without persisting artifacts, or refuse writes; rollup becomes incomplete. Not a secret/RCE issue.

evidence.output: capability_mode: read-only; prompt requires Write artifacts under report_dir; syn uses read-write

findings.acceptance: Domain jobs that persist reports use an explicit reports-only write mode, or parent materializes files from output_schema.
findings.remediation: Keep py-audit-bot product-tree read-only; either parent writes reports/audit/** from structured output or RHAI uses a reports-only write capability (not full workspace-write).
validation: RHAI domain job capability matches artifact write policy
